### What happened today
- Momentum: no fills, no orders. Equity Rs 507,076 (matches the last equity_curve row), day P&L Rs +11,039, total Rs +7,076, charges to date unchanged at Rs 1,280. ADANIPORTS (+7.2%) and DRREDDY (+9.9%) carried; TECHM is -3.9%. Cash Rs 1,202.

- India F&O: all cash, Rs 500,000, no orders. US: all cash, $5,289.62; its Rs +3,836 is entirely the rupee move (USD/INR 95.25 vs 94.52 at start).
- Combined Rs 2,005,151, Rs +5,151 (+0.26%).

### What looks right / what looks wrong
- Right: momentum equity equals the equity curve; the Waaree SELL appears in state/thesis_trades.csv with the same price and realised P&L as the journal; no momentum fills, so nothing else to cross-check; no rejected orders in any sleeve.
- Wrong: nothing found. Waaree filled Rs 268 below yesterday's close (about 2,517 at entry -> 2,249), the loss was already priced in at the open.
- Momentum: holds 5 names, all still in the top 5 by 63-day return and above SMA50; no weak-reason orders proposed.

### Progress vs target
- Momentum averages Rs 708 per day over 10 days against Rs 1,250 pre-tax (gap Rs 542). Too early to read (needs ~60 days). All sleeves combined: Rs +5,151.

- None. No thesis, F&O or US order was queued. Reason: no new idea passes the second-order checklist with a concrete mechanism and written invalidation today; waiting is valid. The Bajaj Finance BUY stays dated 2026-11-19. No catalyst rule is due.
